title: Post-Silicon Validation Engineer
summary: Post-silicon validation engineers test new chips in the lab once the first samples come back from the factory, checking that each block and interface works before the chip goes to customers. They work alongside chip design, verification (pre-silicon testing) and firmware teams in semiconductor companies.
dailyDuties: Write validation plans and test cases for chip features
Bring up new boards and silicon samples in the lab
Write C tests and Python automation for overnight runs
Debug failures with JTAG, oscilloscopes and logic analysers
File and track silicon bugs with the design team
Report pass and fail status for each validation milestone

skills.expectation: Plan and run validation of new chips in the lab, from bring-up to sign-off
Write C test code that programs registers and checks hardware behaviour
Automate test runs, lab equipment and result parsing in Python
Debug failures with JTAG, oscilloscopes and logic analysers
Validate I2C, SPI, UART and similar interfaces
Read block diagrams, timing and register specs to root-cause silicon bugs
Work on Linux test hosts and read system logs
Use kernel drivers and boot logs while bringing up boards
Understand AXI, AHB and APB bus traffic on the SoC
Use Perl or Tcl scripts in the lab flow
Reuse pre-silicon test ideas from the verification team
Run tests on FPGA or emulation platforms before silicon arrives

certifications.why: Shows working Python for test automation
